The river flowed quietly past the old mill town. Fishermen gathered at dawn along
the wooden jetty, and the bakery on the corner filled the morning air with the
smell of fresh bread. By noon the market square was crowded with carts selling
vegetables, cloth, and hand-thrown pottery. Children played near the fountain
while their parents haggled over prices. In the evening the town settled again,
